recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless a future PA decision changes service-animal modeling or the extension location.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Patient Administration change request from DSTU1 asking Practitioner and RelatedPerson usage notes to make clear that service animals can fill those roles, to distinguish Practitioner versus RelatedPerson based on organizational responsibility, and to include a standard species extension.
initial_application: Historical Tracker# 6126 commits 198d23b84ea1cef8dfec5e8e87d117ef4dfd32ab and e3b3e7b337f5f2d17d27230a47b9ad2f52214884 added the RelatedPerson Guide Dog example, the Practitioner service animal example, and the shared Practitioner/RelatedPerson boundary text; daf977bef83c0aef7bafe4019207b7c75d4fc3e6 added the animalSpecies extension hyperlink.
additional_context: Practitioner and RelatedPerson are active PA-owned resources in source/fhir.ini. Later PA decisions FHIR-21242 and FHIR-48870 touched the same pages but preserved the FHIR-6126 service-animal guidance. The animalSpecies extension was removed from core during the R5 extension move, and the FHIR Extension Pack now defines practitioner-animalSpecies for both Practitioner and RelatedPerson with an animal-species value set.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Practitioner and RelatedPerson introduction sources already contain the requested examples, boundary distinction, and extension link.
